summary: MDA Space Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closing of an upsized bought deal offering of 23,000,000 common shares at US$35.60 per share for aggregate gross proceeds of ~US$819 million. The offering was led by BMO Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets, J.P. Morgan, Scotiabank, and BofA Securities. Net proceeds will fund a portion of the cash purchase price for a ~70% interest in Collecte Localisation Satellites (CLS), previously announced on July 8, 2026. An over-allotment option for up to an additional 15% of shares exists, exercisable within 30 days. This transaction represents a capital raise to finance an acquisition, making it a capital return event. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals for the CLS acquisition.
